prompt.project_info: A cinematic, photorealistic winter-forest portrait with a quiet, melancholic, ethereal atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: Young woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, slightly windblown, light blue eyes, fair skin with natural freckles, and a soft introspective, slightly wistful expression. She wears a dark-brown wool coat and a knitted scarf in neutral tones.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait-oriented three-quarter profile with the subject looking back over her shoulder. Snowy forest and soft-focus evergreen trees recede behind her; gentle snowfall remains visibly suspended around her face and coat.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overcast winter daylight, creamy shallow-depth bokeh, muted earth tones, cool greens, and soft whites. Retain natural skin texture and visible snow particles.
prompt.technical_specs: Cinematic portrait photography, vertical 2:3 crop, sharp facial detail, shallow depth of field, highly photorealistic rendering.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Generate a cinematic, photorealistic portrait inspired by a winter forest atmosphere: young woman with long, wavy dark brown hair, slightly windblown, light blue eyes, fair skin with natural freckles, and a soft, introspective, slightly wistful expression. Dark brown wool coat and knitted scarf in neutral tones. Snowy forest with soft-focus evergreen trees, gentle snowfall, winter, quiet, cinematic, melancholic, ethereal mood. Soft natural overcast winter light, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, three-quarter profile, subject looking back over shoulder, ultra-high-resolution sharp facial details, muted earth tones, cool greens and soft whites, natural skin texture, visible snow particles, highly photorealistic, single portrait image, 2:3 aspect ratio.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, cartoon, anime, overly smooth skin, harsh lighting, blurry face, distorted anatomy, oversaturated colors, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If an approved person, wardrobe, or forest reference is attached, preserve the supplied identity where appropriate, long windblown brown hair, wool coat, knitted scarf, snowy evergreen forest, three-quarter look-back composition, and muted winter palette. Individual appearance and forest details may otherwise be replaced.
